trip.note: The bag and the market trip (TODO M5, M6, M11). What the farmer carries to the village: the bag holds load units (the weights of rules/45-weight.json; a normal thing is 1). Capacity = the best carrying thing you own (devices: node id -> load units), at least `base` (what fits in your arms). Packing does not take things out of the store: packed things stay there, marked, and can be unpacked for free. A trip costs `energy.base` x the errand multiplier (a better road, rucksack, boots make it cheaper), at least `energy.min`, and exactly one Time Quiz question.
